whoWeAre.title: Who we are
desc: We bring over 15 years of international experience (United Kingdom) in smart home systems, high-end AV installations, and advanced building automation.

We design and deliver exclusive solutions that seamlessly integrate technology into a perfectly unified system—with a focus on comfort, design, and absolute reliability. We work with premium platforms such as Crestron, Crestron Home, Loxone, and Lutron, enabling intuitive control of lighting, audio, video, shading, and the entire property environment.

We integrate all technologies—from multimedia and lighting to energy management—into a single elegant and easy-to-use platform. The result is a space that responds to user needs and delivers a truly exceptional experience.

Our projects also include advanced property security solutions. We implement professional systems from brands such as Jablotron, Paradox, and Risco, access control solutions like Salto, and modern surveillance and networking technologies from Ubiquiti.
Every project is unique to us—we create tailored solutions that meet the highest standards of security, aesthetics, and technological excellence.

faqs.q: When should smart wiring be planned in a development project?
faqs.a: Ideally in the design phase. Specifying the cabling and system topology before construction avoids costly retrofits and keeps the per-unit price predictable.

faqs.q: How does automation lower the cost of a build?
faqs.a: Loxone Tree uses a single free-form bus instead of star wiring, cutting cabling effort by up to 80% versus a classic new-build installation. One integrated system also replaces several separate ones, reducing material and the number of trades on site.

faqs.q: Do you provide project documentation and inspections?
faqs.a: Yes. We deliver design drawings, standards, material take-offs, ČSN inspection reports and full handover documentation, and coordinate with the building's MEP, construction and IT.

faqs.q: What does smart automation cost per unit?
faqs.a: It depends on the scope and tier. We define a repeatable standard per unit type, so you get a fixed per-unit price that scales predictably across the whole building.

faqs.q: Can one system scale across different unit types?
faqs.a: Yes. The same platform runs from a studio to a penthouse — you only pay for the scope each unit needs, with a consistent standard across the project.

faqs.q: Can buyers extend or customise their unit after moving in?
faqs.a: Yes. Loxone Air adds wireless devices without construction work, so residents can expand lighting, sensors or controls later without new cabling.

faqs.q: Does the system support energy metering and remote readings?
faqs.a: Yes. We integrate energy monitoring and remote meter readings for heat, hot and cold water — increasingly relevant as EU and Czech regulation moves toward mandatory remote metering in new buildings.

faqs.q: Do you coordinate with the construction schedule and other trades?
faqs.a: Yes. We work in phases alongside the build — design, rough-in, fit-out, configuration, inspection and handover — and coordinate directly with the other professions on site.

faqs.q: Does automation help units sell?
faqs.a: Smart features are increasingly expected in new builds and help differentiate units, support premium pricing and appeal to energy-conscious buyers.

faqs.q: Where do you work?
faqs.a: Across the Czech Republic and the wider EU, for residential developments, apartment buildings and commercial projects.

faqs.q: Is Loxone better than traditional smart home systems?
faqs.a: Loxone focuses on true automation rather than simple remote control, reducing the need for manual interaction.

faqs.q: Can Loxone integrate with solar panels?
faqs.a: Yes. Loxone supports advanced energy management and solar integration.

faqs.q: Does Loxone work with smart lighting?
faqs.a: Yes. Lighting automation is one of Loxone's core strengths.

faqs.q: Can Loxone control heating and cooling?
faqs.a: Yes. It provides intelligent climate management across the entire property.

faqs.q: Is Loxone suitable for luxury homes?
faqs.a: Absolutely. Loxone is widely used in premium residential projects throughout Europe.

faqs.q: What is Crestron Home?
faqs.a: Crestron Home is a premium automation platform that connects lighting, climate, entertainment, security, and shading into one intelligent system.

faqs.q: Is Crestron suitable for luxury homes?
faqs.a: Yes. Crestron is widely used in luxury residential projects, villas, penthouses, and premium developments worldwide.

faqs.q: Can Crestron integrate with existing systems?
faqs.a: In many cases, yes. Crestron supports integration with a wide range of third-party technologies.

faqs.q: Can I control my home remotely?
faqs.a: Yes. Crestron allows secure remote access through mobile devices.

faqs.q: Is Crestron better than multiple smart home apps?
faqs.a: Crestron's advantage is centralization. Instead of managing numerous apps, users control all systems from one platform.

office.title: Smart Office & Workspace
description: Turn your workplace into a productive, professional environment. P&A Vision unifies meeting room booking, video conferencing, DALI lighting, shading, climate, and audio/video into a single system that adapts to how your team actually works.

Your team books a room with one tap and the space prepares itself – Zoom or Microsoft Teams launches on the room display, the projection or screen comes down, microphones and speakers activate, and DALI-controlled lighting sets the right scene while blinds adjust to kill glare on camera. A panel by the door shows at a glance whether the room is free or busy, so meetings never overlap.

Run seamless video conferences with automatic camera framing and calibrated room audio – no fiddling with the tech before every call. DALI addressable lighting gives you tunable white and human-centric scenes per fixture, presentation and focus presets, plus per-luminaire dimming that cuts energy use. Combined with efficient climate control, running costs drop while comfort stays high – all monitored and controlled from one place.

We design and deliver meeting room booking, video conferencing, professional audio, and DALI lighting solutions for offices and corporate spaces across the EU. Reliably, elegantly, and with attention to detail.

familyHome.title: Smart Family Home & Villa
description: Create a home that takes care of the whole family. P&A Vision connects lighting, heating, shading, security, and entertainment into one intuitive system powered by Crestron, Loxone, and Lutron – whether it's an apartment, a family house, or a multi-storey villa with grounds to match.

Morning and evening scenes, automated blinds, and zoned temperature control keep every room comfortable – from the kitchen to the master suite, the home cinema to the poolside terrace. The home anticipates your needs and saves energy without any manual adjustment, scaling effortlessly across large villas with dozens of zones.

Peace of mind comes first – control camera systems, smart locks, gates, and access management from your phone, anywhere. Keep an eye on the driveway, garden, and entrances, and stay in touch with what's happening at home, even from another country.
We design and deliver smart family homes and luxury villas across Europe, with a solution tailored to your lifestyle, your property, and your budget.

business.title: Smart Solutions for Business & Commercial Spaces
description: From hotels and restaurants to retail and showrooms – P&A Vision delivers professional automation and network infrastructure for commercial spaces. Structured cabling, Wi-Fi networks, CCTV and security systems, and access control work together as one reliable whole.

A dependable network is the foundation of every operation. We design and build network infrastructure with security at its core – network segmentation, firewall, monitoring, and backup – and connect it with cameras, access systems, and alarms in a single clear interface.

Cut electricity consumption through smart energy management – automatic shutdown of devices, plus lighting and climate control based on occupancy and schedule. You get real-time visibility into costs, and the system scales as your business grows.
We design and integrate networks, security, and energy-saving solutions for businesses across the EU – with a focus on reliability, safety, and a professional appearance.
